text:
alex: Heads-up: nightly CI loadproof failing intermittently after kernel-selector tweak. Seen on dedicated and hosted lanes.

mira: Where's the failure? logs?

alex: Attached snippet from harness stderr: `Latency p95 jumped from 85ms -> 220ms` and KV-hit rate dropped ~12% in first 30s. No OOM.

jonathan: Did selector fallback to slower kernel path? I pushed a change to prefer fp16-fused kernel when seq_len <= 512.

alex: Yes, CI shows kernel tag `fp16_fused_v2` on some shards and `matmul_reference` on others. That's suspicious.

mira: Could be KV cache warmup policy. Our synthetic traffic uses random prefixes; replay uses real prefixes. Which harness was used?

alex: This was the synthetic loadproof harness configured in CI with `--seed=42 --shard=8 --duration=60s`.

jonathan: If seeds cause uneven KV reuse, batching heuristics mis-estimate dp batch sizes. Suggest increasing warmup to 120s and enable deterministic seeding for kernel selection check.

sam: Quick repro: ran local harness with `scripts/loadproof --mode=synthetic --warmup=30 --seed=42`. Dumped kernel decisions: `grep 'kernel=' logs | sort | uniq -c`

```
# kernel counts
120 fp16_fused_v2
80 matmul_reference
```

alex: CI bot: publish dashboard snapshot to perf-dashboard? We need apples-to-apples comparison vs yesterday.

perf-bot: perf-bot: Uploaded snapshot id: snap-2026-03-18-2115. Thresholds exceeded: p95 latency +160% (alert: flaky_threshold).

mira: I think we should revert selector for CI only, and file a perf-regression PR to investigate deeper. Also mark nightly job flaky until resolved.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll open PR to pin kernel selector to previous heuristic for CI lanes and add an explicit kv-cache warmup step to harness.

jonathan: Also adding deterministic kernel tag to logs will help triage quickly. I'll send a patch.

sam: I'll update the CI alert to use p99 instead of p95 for this harness; p95 too noisy with short runs.

perf-bot: ci-bot: Nightly job marked flaky for 3 runs. Investigation created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-987

alex: thanks — filing follow-ups: INF-987 (selector regression), INF-988 (warmup tuning), INF-989 (ci-alert-flakiness).
